_note: Ground truth for the planted-bug set. B* = one planted bug each (class given), C* = written to be clean. A review is correct when it flags a B* sample or passes a C* sample.

B01_Reentrancy.sol.class: SWC-107 reentrancy: balance zeroed after the external call

B03_Selfdestruct.sol.class: SWC-106 unprotected selfdestruct: anyone can close the pool

B04_Delegatecall.sol.class: SWC-112 delegatecall to a caller-supplied address

B05_UncheckedCall.sol.class: SWC-104 unchecked call return: owed zeroed even if the send fails

B06_WeakRandom.sol.class: SWC-120 weak randomness from block values
